items.prompt: I ___ to London in 2019, so I remember the Tube well.
items.explanation: A fixed past time (2019) takes the past simple.
Experience up to now — 'ever' is a classic present perfect marker.

items.prompt: Look — the taxi ___ arrived. Let's go.
items.explanation: A past action with a result relevant now takes the present perfect.

items.prompt: Complete with the correct verb form: She ___ (work) here for five years and loves it.
items.explanation: A duration that continues to the present takes the present perfect.

items.prompt: Rewrite in the present perfect: "I eat sushi." (meaning: at some point in my life)
Find and correct the mistake: "I have finished my homework yesterday."
items.explanation: 'Yesterday' is a finished past time, so the past simple is required.
